Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

Version 0.9.00.0000

  • Added a new function calc_pagerank_ap() to calculate the PageRank of species following Allesina & Pascual (2009).
  • calc_modularity() now computes the modularity from the membership of the partition with igraph::modularity(g, membership, weights), using the ‘weight’ edge attribute when present, instead of returning the value stored in the object returned by the clustering function. That stored value is not comparable between algorithms: for cluster_spinglass() with weights it is not the weighted modularity of the partition (e.g. 0.07 instead of 0.26 in netData[[1]] with random weights), and the one stored by run_infomap() ignored the weights.
  • New argument directed in calc_modularity() (default FALSE): if TRUE and the network is directed the directed modularity is computed. The default is consistent with the default cluster_spinglass(), which ignores the direction of the edges; use directed = TRUE only with algorithms that take the direction into account, such as run_infomap(directed = TRUE). Values with cluster_spinglass() on directed networks can differ slightly from previous versions (e.g. netData[[1]] ~0.18 before, ~0.19-0.20 now).
  • run_infomap() now stores in the returned object the modularity computed with the weights (if present) and the directed argument. Before it was computed ignoring the weights.
  • Fixed the example of run_infomap(), which used a non existent argument.
  • Added tests for the weights in calc_modularity() and for run_infomap().
  • Fixed roxygen warnings in the documentation (citations and a[i,j] notation) and the spelling of “curve ball” in the documentation.
  • Added a pkgdown website https://lsaravia.github.io/multiweb/ built with GitHub Actions, and declared in DESCRIPTION the packages imported but missing (ggplot2, ggrepel, tidygraph, tidyr, tibble, rlang, Matrix, viridis, foreach, future; cowplot in Suggests).
